notes: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix, default branch main-v2, npm reasonix. -p as a switch with a positional prompt is read from internal/cli/cli_flags.go. --auto and -y are not full approval: they equal the default, workspace-write.

resume.note: --resume takes an id, a path or a unique title

options.trust_none_note: a non-interactive read-only run refuses writes and side effects
options.unattended_note: In place of danger-full-access, which runs without Reasonix's filesystem and network sandbox: workspace-write, its default, named so a configured default cannot move it, writes inside the workspace and runs builds and tests in the OS sandbox, and a -p run denies whatever would ask. The network is off unless [sandbox] network allows it, which ao review may need. Read on 2026-09-17 from github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix (main-v2 docs/CLI.md and docs/GUIDE.md).
